summary.en: Kogoro is surprised when the Mouri family arrives at Bal Masqué Restaurant, as the restaurant is currently full due to the ongoing matchmaking party, so they decide to leave and find another restaurant, not knowing that Kogoro has dropped his keys while taking the phone (there’s also sound for us to confirm this). Meanwhile, in Bal Masqué Restaurant, Jugo Yokomizo is seen complaining about his family rushing him to get married, though he’s still enjoying the drink there and assuming that no one would recognize him. Ironically, Chihaya is there and immediately recognizes him while he can’t, so she has to take off the mask not knowing the rule of the party thus making Anju Tomari jealouses. As it turns out, Chihaya comes to the event with her friend, Shinobu Ooe, due to the party being free for women while costing 10.000 yen for men.
